$comment: Cross-client parity fixture (Requirement 13.2, design Property 30). One scenario per file. This case: a confirmed slow LEAK, Spanish locale, canonical L/min + litres units. SCHEMA: `settings` is the AppSettings subset that drives derivation and formatting (flowUnit/volumeUnit are the enum wire tokens 'lpm'|'lph'|'lps'|'usgpm'|'ukgpm'|'m3h' and 'l'|'m3'|'usgal'|'ukgal'; tariffBsPerCubicMetre is Bs. per m3; locale is 'es'|'en'; sensorNames labels channels 0..2). `lines` are REAL protocol lines fed to LeakProtocol.parse; the LAST Telemetry ('D,...') line determines the live readings and Status. Telemetry field order is D,seq,uptime,f1,f2,f3,v1,v2,v3,balance,expected,threshold,status,breachStreak,faultStreak. `windowStats` are pre-built per-window aggregates (day/threeDay/week) so no database is needed: averageLpm feeds the average flow strings and totalLitres feeds the total-volume + Bs strings. `expected` is FLAT and STRING-VALUED — the oracle both the Flutter (17.2) and JS (17.3) parity tests assert equality against. status is LeakStatus.wire. liveFlow[i] is UnitFormatter.flow(flowLpm[i]) (note: flow/volume display strings are NOT locale-formatted — Dart toStringAsFixed always uses '.'). <window>Average is UnitFormatter.flow(averageLpm); <window>Total is UnitFormatter.volume(totalLitres); <window>Cost is CostFormatter.format(totalLitres) = 'Bs. ' + locale-formatted litres/1000*tariff at 2 decimals (es uses ',' decimal + '.' grouping). All strings were derived by running the real Flutter UnitFormatter/CostFormatter/LeakStatus, not hand-computed.
name: slow-leak-es
